description.value: Your bond with your companion sharpens your instincts together. While it's within 10 feet of you: if either of you has a climbing or swimming speed that the other lacks, the other gains that speed at the same value; if you both already have it, you both instead use the higher of the two speeds, increased by a further 5 feet. Additionally, whenever your companion damages a hostile creature you can see on your turn, that counts as you taking a hostile action for the purpose of keeping your rage active. This range grows to 30 feet at 11th level and 60 feet at 17th level.
